Generate RRMS DES Model Inputs

gen_inputs.Rd

Usage

gen_inputs(
  drc = drc,
  drq = drq,
  time_horizon = time_horizon,
  p_eid = p_eid,
  jcvtest_cost = jcvtest_cost
)

Arguments

drc

Numeric. Annual discount rate for costs, expressed as a proportion (e.g. 0.035 for 3.5\

drqNumeric. Annual discount rate for QALYs, expressed as a proportion (e.g. 0.035 for 3.5\time_horizonInteger. Model time horizon in years.p_eidNumeric. Proportion of patients receiving extended interval dosing (EID) of Natalizumab, expressed as a proportion (e.g. 0.6 for 60\ for all patients.jcvtest_costNumeric. Unit cost (£) of a JC virus (JCV) antibody test. Set to 0 if the test is assumed to be provided free of charge (e.g. via manufacturer home service). The private cost is £247. A named list of model inputs. Key elements include:

initial_age

Numeric. Baseline age in years.

time_horizon

Integer. Model time horizon in years.

prop_female

Numeric. Proportion of patients who are female (0.70).

sd_psa

Numeric. Default PSA standard deviation (10).

p_eid

Numeric. Proportion on extended interval dosing.

drc, drq

Numeric. Discount rates for costs and QALYs.

jcvtest_cost

Numeric. JCV test unit cost (£).

m_n_patients_edss

Matrix. Baseline EDSS distribution from the MS Registry.

df_c_tx, df_c_tx_admin, df_c_tx_monitor

Data frames of annual treatment, administration, and monitoring costs per DMT, adjusted for EID and JCV test assumptions.

df_c_tx_load

Data frame of annual treatment scheduled load factors for years 1–5.

v_smr_severity_harding

Matrix. Excess all-cause mortality SMRs by EDSS severity (Harding et al.).

m_proportion_ontrtline

Matrix. Proportions of patients on 2nd and 3rd line treatment.

v_tto_edss_increase_harrms_mu, m_tto_edss_increase_harrms_sigma

Time-to-event parameters for EDSS increase in HARRMS patients (MS Registry).

v_tto_edss_increase_rrms_mu, m_tto_edss_increase_rrms_sigma

Time-to-event parameters for EDSS increase in RRMS patients.

v_tto_edss_increase_spms_mu, m_tto_edss_increase_spms_sigma

Time-to-event parameters for EDSS increase in SPMS patients.

v_tto_edss_decrease_rrms_mu, m_tto_edss_decrease_rrms_sigma

Time-to-event parameters for EDSS decrease in RRMS patients.

v_tto_edss_decrease_spms_mu, m_tto_edss_decrease_spms_sigma

Time-to-event parameters for EDSS decrease in SPMS patients.

v_tto_relapse_harrms_mu, tto_relapse_harrms_sigma

Time-to-event parameters for relapse in HARRMS patients.

v_tto_relapse_spms_mu, m_tto_relapse_spms_sigma

Time-to-event parameters for relapse in SPMS patients.

v_tto_sp_conversion_harrms_mu, m_tto_sp_conversion_harrms_sigma

Time-to-event parameters for secondary progressive conversion in HARRMS patients.

initial_spms_prop

Numeric. Baseline proportion of patients with SPMS (0).

p_relapse_hospital

Numeric. Proportion of relapses leading to hospital admission (Hawton et al. 2026).

sae_names

Character vector of serious adverse event names from AFFIRM.

n_sae

Integer. Number of serious adverse events in the model.

v_weight_sae

Numeric vector. Weights for SAE cost and utility calculations.

m_saes

Matrix. SAE incidence on Natalizumab from AFFIRM (Polman 2006).

v_smr

Numeric vector. Excess all-cause mortality SMRs (Jick 2014).

m_r_mortality

Matrix. ONS all-cause mortality rates by age, male, and female.

m_c_edss_rrms, m_c_edss_spms

Matrices of direct medical costs by EDSS state for RRMS and SPMS (Tyas et al. 2005, inflated to 2022/23).

df_c_spms

Matrix of SPMS treatment costs.

p_siponimod

Numeric. Proportion treated with Siponimod based on MS Registry data (0.557).

m_c_relapse

Matrix of annualised relapse costs (Hawton 2016, inflated to 2023).

df_c_sae

Matrix of serious adverse event costs (MS-MTA report).

m_u_edss_rrms, m_u_edss_spms

Matrices of EDSS utilities for RRMS and SPMS (Orme).

df_u_relapse

Data frame of relapse utilities.

m_u_carer

Matrix of carer disutilities.

df_u_sae

Matrix of serious adverse event disutilities (MS-MTA report).

m_discontinuation

Matrix of baseline discontinuation rates (AFFIRM and Antilope).

m_hr_rrms_cdp3_fe

Matrix. CDP3 NMA hazard ratios (mean, SD).

m_hr_rrms_cdp6_fe

Matrix. CDP6 NMA hazard ratios (mean, SD).

m_hr_rrms_arr_fe

Matrix. ARR NMA rate ratios (mean, SD).

m_hr_rrms_saes_fe

Matrix. SAE NMA rate ratios (mean, SD).

m_hr_rrms_discontinuation_fe

Matrix. Discontinuation NMA hazard ratios (mean, SD).

Generates all model inputs from package data and user-specified assumptions, returning a named list consumed by rrmsdessetup and subsequently passed to rrmsdesmodel via the global inputs object. All default parameter values are stored within this function. The following processing steps are performed before inputs are returned:Population

  • Baseline age is drawn from Normal(36, 8/36) reflecting both arms of the AFFIRM trial (N = 942).

  • Proportion female set to 0.70 (n = 660, AFFIRM).

  • PSA standard deviation set to 1/10 of the mean (sd_psa = 10) where uncertainty is not reported.

Treatment costs (df_c_tx, df_c_tx_admin, df_c_tx_monitor)

  • Row 3 is dropped from each cost matrix and columns are restricted to active treatment names in v_treatment_names.

  • Natalizumab IV and SC (columns 1–4) are adjusted for the proportion on EID using a 5.55-week interval dosing schedule (round(52/5.55, 2)/13).

  • Administration costs for Natalizumab SC in year 1 and year 2 are scaled by s_c_tx_adminyr1_natsc and s_c_tx_adminyr2_natsc respectively (both defaulting to 0.5).

  • Zero administration costs are set to 0.1 to prevent NaN values in downstream calculations.

  • Monitoring costs for all four Natalizumab formulations are reduced by £247 and replaced with jcvtest_cost.

Mortality

  • standardised mortality ratios (SMR) EDSS 8 and 9 are assumed equal to EDSS 7 (Harding et al.).

  • ONS all-cause mortality rates by age, male, ands ex.

Relapse costs

  • Annualisedrelapse costs (Hawton 2016, inflated to 2023)

NMA data

  • Mean and standard deviation columns are extracted from each NMA result object (CDP3, CDP6, ARR, SAEs, discontinuation)
